rounds.hypothesis: A global fixed core plus quarterly valuation tilt can meet return, drawdown and stability goals.
rounds.component_changed: Global allocation and quarterly valuation tilt
rounds.formation_result: Headline CAGR and MDD passed, but 45 percent path-plus-stress and rolling-three-year gates failed.
rounds.rejection_reason: 46.8492 percent path-plus-extreme drawdown and only 43.75 percent of rolling three-year windows above 10 percent CAGR.

rounds.hypothesis: Within a fixed 60 percent equity budget, valuation and relative trend can improve the fixed 60/40 baseline.
rounds.formation_result: C11 passed contaminated formation gates; only two executed state changes were observed.

rounds.hypothesis: A static blend of free cash flow, dividend low volatility and CSI500 quality growth can improve C12 at the same 60 percent equity budget.
rounds.formation_result: All frozen numeric, structure and product-route gates passed; formation CAGR 10.7502 percent and MDD 26.6377 percent.

rounds.hypothesis: C11-style valuation and trend rotation can improve the static C21 factor mix.
rounds.formation_result: CAGR fell 0.2560 percentage points and MDD worsened 1.0387 points versus C21.
rounds.rejection_reason: Strictly worse return, drawdown, Calmar and turnover than the parent.

rounds.hypothesis: A TIPP high-water risk overlay can materially reduce drawdown without excessive return sacrifice.
rounds.formation_result: MDD improved 2.9022 percentage points but CAGR fell 0.7463 points and turnover more than doubled.
rounds.rejection_reason: Return sacrifice and Calmar improvement failed the pre-registered breakthrough path.

rounds.hypothesis: A small static ChiNext momentum-growth satellite adds an independent return source without breaking risk limits.
rounds.component_changed: Five or ten percent growth-momentum satellite
rounds.formation_result: Both variants passed common gates; the ten percent variant did not dominate the five percent variant under the frozen rule.

rounds.hypothesis: A ten percent convertible-bond bridge improves convexity and portfolio efficiency.
rounds.formation_result: CAGR fell 0.1953 percentage points; MDD improved only 0.3268 points.
rounds.rejection_reason: Neither the return-efficiency nor risk-efficiency breakthrough path passed.

rounds.hypothesis: A monthly trend gate on only the five percent AI/growth optionality sleeve can buy cheap tail insurance.
rounds.formation_result: Same-window CAGR fell 0.3175 percentage points and MDD improved only 0.4597 points while turnover rose.
rounds.rejection_reason: Insurance benefit was below the pre-registered threshold and return sacrifice was too high.

rounds.hypothesis: Replacing the short policy-bank-bond sleeve with a long-duration fund improves the growth-inflation barbell without changing equity risk.
rounds.formation_result: Versus C23 in the same limited window, CAGR improved 0.3795 percentage points, MDD improved 0.2297 points and Calmar improved 0.0696.
